label: hAP ac
description: MikroTik hAP ac (RB962UiGS-5HacT2HnT) — 5x 1G RJ45, 1x SFP, Wi-Fi 2.4 GHz + 5 GHz. MIPSBE 1-core QCA9558.
notes: Power method from the mikrotik.com spec table: **PoE in: Passive PoE** (11-57 V) on `eth1`; **PoE out on `eth5`** - it powers the device above it on the mast or the AP on the wall, and the port is the vendor's own, not a convention. Input is recorded on the first Ethernet port because the table states the method and voltage but does not name the port, and every MikroTik with a PoE-IN DC input takes it there. Max power consumption 17 W.
